items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: George Barkay was a great big fella.

ctx.x: Did he have as much rhythm as Joe?

Oh yes, I think. In fact, I thought Freddie was as good as all of them. Exactly about it. Besides, he kept Freddie didn't say much, but I thought Freddie was as good as all of them. items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: And George Abake was a master.

ctx.x: What about Big Al Louis Robertson, the piano player, not Big Al Louis the clarinet player? Do you know him? Sir Robertson, no, I don't know. What about Cato? Do you know him?
